title: Fix launchSettings environment name mismatch
description:
P1 finding from 10-agent swarm codebase audit (P1-015). launchSettings sets ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT to 'LocalDevelopment' but the only development settings file is named appsettings.Development.json. The Development settings overrides are never loaded during local development.

File: MemorySmith.App/Properties/launchSettings.json
Confidence: 100%
Source: codebase-audit-20260710-agent10-swarm-v2.md
